create_openloop_client_runner: create an OpenLoopClientRunner that sends requests at fixed intervals using a generator
create_closedloop_client_runner: create a ClosedLoopClientRunner that sends new requests in response to each completed request
start_client_runner: start a ClientRunner to begin dispatching requests to the gRPC client
stop_client_runner: stop a running ClientRunner and clean up the client reference
review_client_runner_classes: review the ClientRunner abstract class and its OpenLoop and ClosedLoop implementations
